activities.activity_description: Implement the ability to change the namespace to isolate ZK metadata based on each tenant profile (U1).
Implement interactive username and password input for Admin server access, ensuring credentials are not logged (U2).
Establish the maintenance branch process to allow committing MINOR release code changes instead of committing to MASTER (U3).
Clean-up deprecated functions such as download of module definitions, and clean-up Shell and Admin-UI modules following module registry refactoring (U4).
Research and implement the ability to access the random port of the admin server via xd-shell, evaluating direct ZK connection vs Load Balancer (U5).

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Kafka Consumer and Rerun Tests
activities.activity_description: Upgrade to the new Kafka 0.9 consumer rewrite and rerun failing tests to ensure compatibility (U6).
Research the feasibility of implementing Motion-JPEG for audio/video stream ingest and create design specs for predictive analytics (U7).
Add a configuration parameter in servers.yml to enable/disable message rates in the cluster view (U8).
Perform end-to-end integration testing of all implemented features and prepare the software increment for deployment.
